findings.evidence: PR3-001's root-level contradiction is corrected: data-model.md now reproduces the canonical 19-member root and explicitly excludes rowCounts and completeness. However, the sole owning Story 4.1 grammar types coverage only as bounded counts/booleans and does not enumerate its closed member names, requiredness, nesting, or bounds. The plan says the former rowCounts and completeness facts move into coverage and projectionObservations but does not map the three row-count facts or seven completeness facts to exact contract fields. The existing Python runner emits projectionA/projectionB/combined under root rowCounts and seven named flags under root completeness, while the C# verifier reads those exact roots. Removing those roots therefore leaves two independently implemented components free to choose different nested names while the contract simultaneously requires unknown nested fields to fail and claims every nested field is validated exactly. The corrected root is unambiguous, but the complete closed schema remains non-implementable from one authority.
